cointreau.en: Slightly sweeter and less intense orange.

simple_syrup.en: Use 2/3 of the amount; earthy sweetness.
Caramel notes, great with dark spirits.

sugar.en: Use 15 ml syrup per teaspoon of sugar.

sweet_vermouth.en: Fruitier and sweeter; use a little less.
sweet_vermouth.de: Fruchtiger und süßer; etwas weniger nehmen.

lillet.en: Drier; add a dash of syrup.

aperol.en: More bitter and stronger; use less.

lemon_soda.en: Add a little syrup and lemon.

absinthe.en: Infuse star anise in the glass.

falernum.en: Almond instead of spice; add a dash of Angostura.
falernum.de: Mandel statt Gewürz; Spritzer Angostura dazu.

spiced_rum.en: Less vanilla & spice; add a dash of Angostura.
spiced_rum.de: Weniger Vanille & Gewürz; einen Spritzer Angostura dazu.

lime_cordial.en: Add 15 ml simple syrup per 15 ml juice.

sour_mix.en: Mix equal parts lemon juice & simple syrup.

pink_gin.en: Add a few drops of raspberry syrup.
